clips.title: The story
paras: Across the sea, Call of Water carries Barrens shamans to Silverpine Forest. There, an initiate faces the blight on an ancient coastal shrine to earn communion with water spirits.

After gathering drops of pure water with help from the hermit Brine, you return to Islen Waterseer on the Barrens coast. She sends you across the sea with the purified essence to Silverpine Forest's haunted shore, just west of the Forsaken refuge called the Sepulcher.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.
Take the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.
Bring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The brazier still reflects the ambient light from the area, and the flame shifts slightly as you move closer.
The corruption along the hills seems to have kept its distance, and besides the missing components, the brazier looks prepared for the ritual to summon a cleansed manifestation of water.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the bracers atop the brazier and then pour the remaining drops of Brine's potion into the flame. The drops crackle as they hit the flame and you begin to incant the simple words Islen taught you....
